job_vi: Ảnh sản phẩm nền trắng để đăng bán
job_en: Packshot on white for a marketplace listing
use_when: The platform requires a plain background and the product must be identifiable at thumbnail size
copy_safe: None — the platform draws its own text over the tile
subject_action: One unit of the product standing upright and square to camera, label facing the lens, nothing else in frame
scene: Seamless white sweep with a faint gradient at the bottom so the product does not float
lighting: One large soft source from front-left at 45 degrees, plus a white bounce card at right; a soft contact shadow directly under the base
camera: Eye level with the product's midpoint, 85-100mm behaviour so the silhouette does not bow
materials: True material: glass reads as glass with one soft highlight and one refracted edge, matte plastic has no highlight at all
avoid: No reflection under the product unless the surface is glass, no drop shadow floating away from the base, no invented label text
fails_when: The product is lit so evenly it reads as a 3D render; one side needs to fall off

job_vi: Ảnh sản phẩm trong bối cảnh dùng thật
job_en: Packshot in the situation it is used in
use_when: The buyer cannot picture where the product belongs, or scale is unclear
subject_action: One unit in the hand or on the surface where it is actually used, positioned as a real person would leave it
scene: The real room or counter it belongs to, kept shallow so only one plane of context reads
lighting: Motivated light: name the window or lamp already in that room and let it fall from one side
camera: Slightly above eye level looking down at 20-30 degrees, 35-50mm behaviour to keep the room legible
materials: Everything in frame must be something the owner would actually have; one worn or used object beats three new ones
avoid: No marble slab, no pastel pedestal, no props whose only job is mood
fails_when: Every object is new and nothing has been touched; it reads as a showroom, not a life

job_vi: Ảnh món ăn cho app giao đồ ăn
job_en: Dish hero for a delivery app tile
use_when: The dish will be judged in one second against twenty other tiles at 320px wide
copy_safe: None — the app overlays its own price and name
subject_action: One portion of the dish plated as it is actually served, filling 70 percent of the frame, cut or opened so the inside reads
scene: The shop's own counter or table, cropped so tightly that only tone remains behind
lighting: One large soft source from camera-left raking across the surface so sheen and texture read; no top light
camera: 30-40 degrees above the plate, 50mm behaviour, close enough that the plate rim leaves the frame
materials: Sauce is glossy but not gelled, rice is separate and steaming, greens are cut and slightly bruised, meat shows grain
avoid: No garnish the shop does not serve, no chopsticks standing upright, no styling gel, no impossible steam plume
fails_when: The dish is centred and complete and reads as a stock photo; a delivery tile needs the food broken into

job_vi: Tô bún phở trên quầy quán
job_en: Noodle bowl on the shop's own counter
use_when: A noodle shop wants one image that works on the menu header and a post
subject_action: One bowl at a shallow three-quarter angle, broth surface visible, toppings resting against the far rim, herbs on the counter beside it
scene: The shop's stainless counter at mid-morning, the stock pot soft behind camera-right and clear of the copy area
lighting: One large soft source from camera-left at 45 degrees standing in for the doorway, raking the broth so the sheen reads
camera: 30 degrees above the counter, 50-65mm behaviour from arm's length, no wide-angle bowl distortion
materials: Broth translucent with fat rings, not opaque; noodles wet and separate, not clumped; one visible tendon line in the meat
avoid: No second bowl, no hands, no restaurant interior behind, no ice
fails_when: The broth is opaque and orange; that is the single tell that separates a real bowl from a generated one

job_vi: Ly nước lạnh có hơi nước đọng
job_en: Cold drink with real condensation
use_when: A drink is being sold on refreshment and the picture must look cold
subject_action: One glass three-quarters full, ice visible and irregular, one straw or none, condensation beading unevenly and running in two or three tracks
scene: A plain surface with one out-of-focus plant or window edge, nothing else
lighting: Backlight three-quarters behind at camera-right so the liquid glows through and the beads catch rim light; low fill in front
camera: Slightly below the rim so the liquid column reads full height, 85mm behaviour
materials: Ice is irregular and partly melted, beads vary in size and only some have run, the liquid is translucent not flat colour
avoid: No perfectly even bead pattern, no frozen splash, no floating fruit, no glow the scene cannot cast
fails_when: Uniform beads and clear cube-perfect ice; both read instantly as generated

job_vi: Quầy nướng đường phố có khói
job_en: Street grill with real smoke
use_when: A streetfood seller sells on smell and theatre
copy_safe: Bottom 40 percent for the app's own interface
subject_action: The skewers or meat on the grate mid-cook, one hand turning them, smoke rising from the coals in an uneven column
scene: The actual stall at dusk, the street behind reduced to warm points of light
lighting: Coals as the low warm source plus one hard source from behind so the smoke separates against the dark; nothing frontal
camera: Low, near grate height, 35mm behaviour so the stall reads around the food
materials: Char is uneven, fat is visibly rendering, smoke is thin and directional, not a plume
avoid: No symmetric smoke, no fire that lights nothing, no clean apron, no empty street behind a busy stall
fails_when: The smoke is dense and centred like a special effect; real smoke is thin, tilted, and broken

job_vi: Bánh mì cắt ngang thấy nhân
job_en: Cross-section so the filling is the proof
use_when: The whole claim is what is inside and a closed product hides it
subject_action: One unit cut clean across and stood or leaned so the section faces the lens, the second half behind and soft
scene: A paper wrap or board directly under it, nothing else in frame
lighting: Soft source from front-left plus a bounce at right so the section has no black voids; a raking kicker to show crumb texture
camera: Straight on at the section, 100mm behaviour, so the layers are not distorted
materials: Crumb is open and irregular, pâté is matte, cucumber is wet, chilli edges are cut not torn
avoid: No filling stacked in a way it could not survive being closed, no perfect symmetry, no sauce drip added afterwards
fails_when: The section is styled so full it could never have been wrapped; a buyer reads that as a lie

job_vi: Rót cà phê hoặc pha chế đang diễn ra
job_en: A pour or preparation caught mid-action
use_when: The craft of making it is the differentiator
subject_action: The liquid mid-pour between vessel and cup, one hand on the vessel, the stream unbroken and slightly off vertical
scene: The bar or counter where it is actually made, the back bar dissolved to tone
lighting: One hard-ish source from behind camera-left so the stream is edge-lit and translucent; soft fill from the front
camera: Slightly above the cup, 50mm behaviour, close enough that the hand and cup fill the frame
materials: The stream tapers and is not a cylinder, the crema is uneven, the cup interior is wet
avoid: No frozen droplet crown, no stream that touches nothing, no second unexplained hand
fails_when: The pour is frozen into a sculpture; a real stream is slightly blurred and never symmetric

job_vi: Bàn ăn nhiều người, lẩu hoặc nướng chung
job_en: A shared table, hotpot or grill for a group
use_when: The product is the occasion, not the dish
subject_action: The pot or grill live in the centre of the table with four to six sets of hands reaching in, one person mid-serve, plates and glasses at real angles
scene: A real table in the room it is served in, the room behind soft and warm
lighting: The overhead lamp already above that table as the key, plus the burner glow as the low warm source; no added light
camera: Standing above the near edge at 45 degrees, 24-35mm behaviour so the whole table reads
materials: Some plates are half eaten, condensation on the glasses, a used napkin, steam rising unevenly
avoid: No untouched perfect table, no faces looking at camera, no matched crockery if the shop's is not matched
fails_when: Nothing has been eaten yet; a shared table sells the middle of the meal, not the start

job_vi: Ảnh gói snack, mì, bánh đóng gói
job_en: Packaged food where the pack is the product
use_when: The pack must be recognisable on a shelf and the food inside must be shown honestly
subject_action: The sealed pack upright and square with the front panel readable, and a small portion of the actual contents beside it on the surface
scene: A single-tone surface a half stop darker than the pack so the pack separates
lighting: Soft source front-left at 45 degrees, one bounce right, and a small hard kicker to read the foil texture
camera: Eye level with the pack's midpoint, 100mm behaviour so the panel is not keystoned
materials: Foil has crinkle and gradient rather than flat colour; the loose portion looks like the real contents, not an idealised version
avoid: No invented pack text of any kind, no serving suggestion that exaggerates the contents, no crumbs arranged in an arc
fails_when: The loose food looks better than what is actually in the pack; that is the claim risk, not a styling choice

job_vi: Chai lọ mỹ phẩm, serum, dầu
job_en: A bottle or jar of a cosmetic or serum
use_when: Premium positioning where the container carries the price
subject_action: One bottle standing, dropper or cap in place, label square to camera, no second unit
scene: A shallow tone-on-tone surface and back wall, separated by a soft light falloff rather than an edge
lighting: One narrow soft strip source behind camera-left so the glass gets one long vertical highlight; a black card at right to keep the other edge dark
camera: Eye level or one degree below, 100mm behaviour, tight so the bottle nearly fills the height
materials: Glass shows one clean highlight and refracts the surface behind it; liquid level is visible; the cap is metal or plastic, and the render must pick one
avoid: No water droplets unless the product is used wet, no petals, no marble, no gold flecks, no second reflection the set cannot cast
fails_when: Two competing highlights on the glass; that is how glass renders look fake even when everything else is right

job_vi: Vệt kem, gel, bột để chứng minh chất
job_en: A smear or swatch that proves the texture
use_when: A cream, gel or powder is being sold on how it feels
subject_action: One swatch of the product drawn across the surface in a single motion, thick at the start and thinning out, with the trailing edge broken
scene: A plain surface the product's own colour minus saturation, filling the frame
lighting: One hard raking source almost parallel to the surface from the right so peaks cast their own small shadows
camera: Straight down at 90 degrees, 100mm macro behaviour
materials: A gel holds a dome and shows internal highlights; a cream holds peaks; a powder holds a scatter edge — each must behave like its own class
avoid: No swatch that behaves like a different material, no perfect arc, no glitter added
fails_when: The swatch is drawn as a neat arc; a real swatch is uneven and shows the drag

job_vi: Sản phẩm trên da thật
job_en: The product on real skin
use_when: The proof is how it sits on skin, and stock-clean skin is not credible
subject_action: A hand or cheek with the product applied and partly worked in, one visible finger track, at the moment before it disappears
scene: A plain wall behind, cropped so no room reads
lighting: One large soft source from front-left plus a low bounce so the skin keeps its own texture
camera: Close, 85-100mm behaviour, at the angle a person would look at their own arm
materials: Pores, fine hair, one mole or freckle, uneven tone; the product sits wet on top rather than being blended out of existence
avoid: No airbrushed skin, no waxy plastic surface, no visible retouch smoothing, no unblemished uniform tone
fails_when: The skin has no pores; every viewer sees it and it kills the product claim with it

job_vi: Trải phẳng quần áo để xem hết chi tiết
job_en: Flatlay so the whole garment reads
use_when: A listing needs the full shape, colour and every detail in one frame
subject_action: One garment laid flat and squared to frame, sleeves placed as if just folded out, one deliberate fold to show the drape
scene: A single-tone fabric or paper ground one stop off the garment's own value
lighting: Two large soft sources at 45 degrees from opposite sides so the weave reads and no side goes flat
camera: Directly above at 90 degrees, 50mm behaviour from far enough that the corners do not stretch
materials: Weave or knit is visible, the seam allowance shows, the hem is not ironed into a line the garment does not hold
avoid: No garment floating, no invented brand tag, no shadow direction that contradicts the two sources
fails_when: The garment is arranged into a perfect rectangle; real fabric does not lie that flat

job_vi: Quần áo trên người mẫu
job_en: The garment on a body
use_when: Fit and movement are the decision, and flat fabric cannot show them
subject_action: A fictional adult wearing the garment, standing in a relaxed asymmetric stance, weight on one leg, hands doing something rather than nothing
scene: A plain wall or a single real location kept shallow
lighting: One large soft source from front-left at 45 degrees, one bounce right, and enough separation that the garment edge does not merge with the wall
camera: Slightly below eye level for a full-length, 85mm behaviour so proportions stay honest
materials: Fabric creases where a body bends it; the shoulder seam sits where it actually sits; shoes and skin are real
avoid: No face drift from a supplied reference, no impossible waist, no fabric that hangs as if there is no body under it
fails_when: The garment fits with no wrinkle anywhere; the buyer reads it as not-real and stops trusting the fit

job_vi: Ảnh giày một chiếc, thấy được sole
job_en: One shoe where the construction reads
use_when: Footwear sells on the sole, the stitch and the profile
subject_action: One shoe in three-quarter profile, tilted so the outsole edge and the toe box both read, laces tied loosely and asymmetric
scene: A plain surface with a soft contact shadow, nothing else
lighting: Soft source front-left, hard kicker from behind-right to read the stitch and the sole texture, bounce under the toe
camera: Slightly above the shoe, 100mm behaviour so the profile is not distorted
materials: Leather creases at the flex point, the midsole shows foam texture rather than flat white, the eyelets have metal specularity
avoid: No mirrored second shoe, no floating, no laces arranged into a bow they would not hold
fails_when: The upper reads as a smooth solid; leather without pores or grain is the tell

job_vi: Trang sức chụp macro
job_en: Jewellery at macro so the setting reads
use_when: A small object carries a high price and the craft must be visible
subject_action: One piece filling the frame, angled so the stone's table and one facet edge both catch light, the setting claws visible
scene: A dark tone-on-tone surface with a soft gradient so the metal has something to reflect
lighting: A small soft source close and above for the metal, plus one tiny hard source to make one facet flare; black cards to keep the metal from going white
camera: Straight on or five degrees above, 100mm macro behaviour, stacked focus behaviour so front and back claws are both sharp
materials: Metal reflects the room, not a uniform colour; the stone has internal refraction and one inclusion; the surface shows fine tool marks
avoid: No uniform glow inside the stone, no star flare the set cannot cast, no invented carat or hallmark text
fails_when: The stone glows from inside with no light source; a real stone bounces the room back at you

job_vi: Ảnh thiết bị điện tử
job_en: A device where the finish is the pitch
use_when: Aluminium, glass and screen finish carry the premium read
subject_action: The device three-quarter on, screen dark or showing a solid tone, ports and edge radius visible along one side
scene: A dark surface with a long soft gradient behind, so the anodised edge has a gradient to reflect
lighting: One long soft strip from above-behind to draw the top edge, one narrow strip at camera-left for the side, black cards elsewhere
camera: Slightly above, 100mm behaviour, tight so the body fills the width
materials: Anodised metal is matte with a directional grain; glass has one specular and one diffuse component; the screen reflects the room faintly even when off
avoid: No invented UI on the screen, no glow leaking out of a dark screen, no seam that does not exist on the real unit
fails_when: The screen shows a made-up interface; that becomes a product claim you cannot support

job_vi: Nội thất trong phòng thật
job_en: Furniture in a room, at real scale
use_when: Scale and the room it suits are the whole decision
subject_action: One piece as the clear subject, positioned as it would be used, one supporting object on it that gives scale
scene: A real room with the far wall visible, floor line visible, two thirds of the room legible
lighting: Motivated daylight from one named window at frame-left, no fill beyond what the room's own walls bounce
camera: Standing height, camera level so verticals stay vertical, 24-35mm behaviour, no tilt
materials: Wood shows grain and one repair or knot; upholstery shows a seat impression; the floor shows real wear
avoid: No impossible perspective, no second light source with no window, no perfectly empty otherwise-lived-in room
fails_when: Verticals converge; a tilted camera makes furniture look like a render every time

job_vi: Concept bao bì chưa có mẫu thật
job_en: A packaging concept where no real pack exists yet
use_when: The pack is being designed and there is nothing to photograph
copy_safe: Bottom 30 percent for the concept label
subject_action: The pack form only, in flat brand colour with no text at all, one unit standing and one lying
scene: A neutral studio ground with a soft contact shadow
lighting: Soft source front-left, bounce right, so the form reads as a form and not as a photograph of a product
camera: Eye level, 100mm behaviour
materials: The material class must be stated and honoured: carton has a visible fold and fibre edge, pouch has a bottom gusset and crinkle
avoid: No text, no logo, no barcode, no seal graphics — every one of them is a claim about a pack that does not exist
fails_when: It looks like a finished pack; then someone sends it to a printer. Always ship this with a concept label

job_vi: Khung ảnh mở hộp
job_en: The moment the box opens
use_when: First impression and what is included are the pitch
subject_action: The box open at about 40 degrees with the contents still seated in place, two hands lifting the lid or the insert
scene: A plain table with only what came in the box on it
lighting: One soft source from above-front-left and a bounce so the box interior is not a black hole
camera: 45 degrees above, 35-50mm behaviour so the box interior reads
materials: Card has fibre and a visible crease at the fold; tissue is creased where a hand touched it; the insert holds the contents at their real angles
avoid: No items floating above the box, no contents fanned out in a symmetric arc, no extras that do not ship
fails_when: The contents are arranged into a display; unboxing sells the seated arrangement, not a laid-out kit

job_vi: Ảnh so sánh kích thước
job_en: A frame that settles the size question
use_when: Returns or questions keep coming from people who misjudged the size
copy_safe: Bottom strip for the measurement caption
subject_action: The product beside one object whose size everyone already knows, both flat to the same plane, touching or nearly
scene: A plain surface with a scale line or ruler edge along one side if the number is confirmed
lighting: Flat even soft light from the front so neither object casts a shadow that misreads as depth
camera: Straight down at 90 degrees or dead-on at eye level, 100mm behaviour, no perspective at all
materials: Both objects genuinely on one plane, because any depth difference here becomes a lying comparison
avoid: No comparison object of ambiguous size, no perspective trick, no printed dimension unless it is confirmed
fails_when: One object is nearer the lens than the other; the comparison then overstates or understates and you get more returns

job_vi: Ảnh trước và sau
job_en: A before and after pair
use_when: A result is the claim and one frame cannot carry it
copy_safe: None — the pair is labelled in layout
subject_action: Two frames of the identical subject from the identical position, changing only the thing the product changed
scene: The identical background, unchanged between the two frames
lighting: Identical light in both frames: same source, same position, same power, same white balance
camera: Identical camera position, height, lens, distance and exposure in both frames
materials: Everything not being claimed must be visibly the same, down to the fold of a sleeve
avoid: No change of light, angle, crop, makeup, wardrobe, posture or grade between the frames
fails_when: The after frame is better lit than the before. That is not a result, it is a lighting change, and it is the most common false claim in this category

job_vi: Chân dung chủ doanh nghiệp, đáng tin
job_en: A founder portrait that reads credible
use_when: A buyer is deciding whether to trust a small business behind the product
subject_action: A fictional adult or the authorised real person, three-quarter to camera, shoulders turned slightly off axis, hands occupied by something from their actual work
scene: Their real workplace, kept shallow so one plane of it reads and the copy area stays quiet
lighting: One large soft source at 45 degrees and 30 degrees above from camera-left, low bounce at right, so one side of the face keeps shadow
camera: Eye level exactly, 85mm behaviour from two metres
materials: Skin keeps pores, lines and asymmetry; the shirt has real creases; the eyes have one catchlight from the named source
avoid: No two catchlights, no smoothed skin, no whitened teeth, no arms crossed, no studio grey backdrop for a workshop business
fails_when: Both eyes have symmetric ring-light catchlights and the skin is flawless; credibility drops the moment it looks retouched

job_vi: Nhân viên đang làm việc thật
job_en: Staff mid-task, not posing
use_when: Service is the product and process is the proof
subject_action: One or two people doing the actual task, eyes on the work rather than the camera, mid-motion with one hand blurred if the motion is fast
scene: The real workspace, in use, with the mess it actually has
lighting: The workspace's own light named as key; add only a bounce, never a second source that the room could not have
camera: At the height a colleague would stand, 35mm behaviour, close enough to be inside the task
materials: Uniforms have wear, the surfaces have marks, the tools have been used
avoid: No one looking at camera, no tidied bench, no matching new uniforms if the shop's are not new
fails_when: Everyone is looking at the lens and smiling; that is a staff photo, not proof of work

job_vi: Khách hàng đang dùng sản phẩm
job_en: A customer using the product where they use it
use_when: The buyer needs to see themselves, not a model
subject_action: A fictional adult using the product at the real moment of use, attention on the product or the task, body language unposed
scene: The place that use actually happens, with its real clutter kept behind the subject
lighting: The light that place actually has at that hour, from one direction, plus a bounce
camera: At the height a companion would be, 35-50mm behaviour
materials: Clothing, room and product all show that this is the middle of a day, not the start of a shoot
avoid: No model-perfect grooming, no direct-to-camera smile while using a product, no empty spotless room
fails_when: The person is a model in a set. The whole value of this recipe is that they are not

job_vi: Ảnh khách tự chụp kiểu UGC
job_en: A UGC-style frame the audience reads as a real customer
use_when: Paid-looking creative is being scrolled past and social proof is what is missing
copy_safe: Middle band only — the app takes the top 250px and bottom 420px
subject_action: A fictional adult holding the product toward the lens at arm's length, off-centre, slightly out of level, mid-sentence rather than smiling
scene: Wherever they actually are: a car, a bathroom, a desk, an untidy room
lighting: Whatever light is there, including mixed colour temperature and one blown window, because correcting it removes the whole effect
camera: Phone front-camera behaviour: wide, close, mild barrel distortion, slight motion blur
materials: Slightly soft focus, visible sensor noise, uneven exposure, the product label partly cut by the hand
avoid: No studio lighting, no clean composition, no colour grade, no perfect exposure — every one of them breaks the read
fails_when: It is well composed and well lit. UGC works because it is not, and a polished UGC frame performs worse than an honest ad

job_vi: Chỉ có tay, thao tác sản phẩm
job_en: Hands only, demonstrating the mechanism
use_when: How it works is the pitch and a face would compete with it
subject_action: Two hands performing one step of the actual operation, the product held at the angle the step requires, mid-motion
scene: A plain work surface, cropped so no room reads
lighting: One soft source from above-front so both hands and the product are legible, one bounce to keep the palms from going dark
camera: Over the shoulder at 60 degrees, 50mm behaviour, tight to the hands
materials: Nails, knuckles, one small scar; the grip is a grip that would actually work for that step
avoid: No sixth finger, no duplicated thumb, no floating product, no grip that could not apply the force shown
fails_when: Anatomy fails. Hands are still where generated images break, so this recipe always needs a real render check

job_vi: Khung ảnh cho lời chứng thực
job_en: A frame built to carry a quote
use_when: A real approved quote exists and needs a picture
copy_safe: Right 55 percent, and it must stay genuinely empty
subject_action: The person from the shoulders up in the left 45 percent, looking slightly out of frame rather than at the lens
scene: A dark or single-tone plane behind so type will sit on it at full contrast
lighting: One soft source from the subject's front-left, deep falloff into the copy side so the type area is even and dark
camera: Eye level, 85mm behaviour
materials: Skin, hair and fabric keep texture; the copy side is a clean tonal field with no gradient banding
avoid: No detail whatsoever in the copy area, no hair strays crossing into it, no invented quote rendered as image text
fails_when: The scene fills the reserved area. A reserved area the scene fills is not a reserved area

job_vi: Cận cảnh beauty, makeup
job_en: A beauty close-up where the makeup is the subject
use_when: A colour, finish or technique is the product
subject_action: A fictional adult's face from brow to chin, turned five degrees off axis, eyes open and level, the makeup at its finished state
scene: A seamless tone one stop darker than the skin
lighting: One large soft source directly above and slightly front for butterfly lighting, a bounce below the chin, black cards at both sides for shape
camera: Straight on at eye level, 100mm behaviour
materials: Skin keeps pores and fine hair; the product reads as its stated finish, matte or satin or metallic, and the render must pick one; lashes are separate and uneven
avoid: No poreless skin, no symmetric face, no whitened sclera, no lash comb pattern, no change to the underlying facial structure
fails_when: Makeup direction quietly becomes face reconstruction. Lock structure, asymmetry, age and expression, and reject a prettier face

job_vi: Ảnh thời trang kiểu editorial
job_en: An editorial fashion frame
use_when: The brand is being positioned rather than a garment sold
subject_action: A fictional adult in one deliberate pose that has a reason, garment shape as the subject, limbs making one clear shape against the ground
scene: One authored location or one seamless colour, chosen and not defaulted
lighting: One hard or one large source, committed to; editorial reads as a decision, and two competing softboxes read as a catalogue
camera: Below eye level for authority or above for vulnerability — pick one, 50-85mm behaviour
materials: Fabric behaves like its fibre; skin keeps texture; the location has real dirt or wear if it is a real location
avoid: No pose without a reason, no imitation of a named living photographer or campaign, no floating fabric with no wind source
fails_when: It is a catalogue shot with the contrast raised. Editorial is a decision about the frame, not a grade

job_vi: Ảnh nhóm, tập thể công ty
job_en: A group frame that does not read as a stock photo
use_when: Trust in the organisation is what is being sold
subject_action: Three to seven people at varied distances from the lens, not in a line, some in conversation, one or two acknowledging the camera
scene: The real premises, with depth so the group sits inside a space
lighting: One broad soft source or the room's own window as key, plus enough fill that no face in the back row is lost
camera: Eye level, 35mm behaviour, far enough that the outer faces are not stretched
materials: Different heights, ages, clothing and postures; the room is theirs and shows it
avoid: No straight line, no matched poses, no arms crossed in unison, no faces all turned to the lens with the same smile
fails_when: Everyone is arranged by height and smiling identically. That single arrangement makes a real team look bought

job_vi: Mặt tiền cửa hàng
job_en: The storefront as a findable place
use_when: A local buyer needs to recognise the place from the street
subject_action: The full frontage with the entrance visible and one person entering or standing, the sign readable but not straightened by software
scene: The actual street, with its actual pavement, wires and neighbours
lighting: Late-afternoon daylight from one side so the facade has modelling; the interior lights on so the inside reads warm against it
camera: Standing height across the street, camera level so the building's verticals stay vertical, 24-35mm behaviour
materials: The building shows its age; the pavement is not empty; the neighbouring shopfronts are not erased
avoid: No verticals converging, no removed neighbours, no invented sign text, no impossible empty street on a busy road
fails_when: The street is emptied and the facade is straightened. It stops being findable, which was the only job

job_vi: Nội thất quán, không gian
job_en: The room as the reason to come in
use_when: Atmosphere is the product
subject_action: The room from one corner with the seating, the counter and the depth all reading, two or three people seated at real distances
scene: The room as it is at its best hour, in use
lighting: The room's own fixtures as key, one window as fill; expose for the warm interior and let the window blow slightly, as an eye would
camera: Seated height, camera level, 24mm behaviour from the corner, verticals straight
materials: Surfaces show wear, the tables have things on them, the light has one colour temperature the room actually has
avoid: No empty room presented as an atmosphere, no added lights, no HDR flattening that removes every shadow
fails_when: Nobody is in it. An empty room reads as closed, whatever the caption says

job_vi: Giao hàng bằng xe máy
job_en: Motorbike delivery, which is how it actually arrives
use_when: Speed and reach are the pitch in a Vietnamese city
subject_action: A rider stopped at the kerb handing a bag over, or the box strapped to the rear rack with the strap visibly tight, mid-transaction
scene: The real street, shophouses and wires behind, kept shallow
lighting: Daylight from one side; late afternoon so the helmet and the bag both have modelling
camera: Standing height, slightly above the bag, 35-50mm behaviour
materials: The bag is used, the strap is worn, the bike is a bike someone rides daily
avoid: No pristine bike, no empty street, no invented courier branding, no helmet worn unbuckled
fails_when: Everything is new. A delivery frame is credible because the equipment is worn

job_vi: Sạp chợ, hàng rong, ghế nhựa
job_en: A market stall or pavement seating
use_when: Provenance and everyday-ness are the pitch
subject_action: The stall with its goods stacked the way the seller stacks them, the seller's hands working, one customer at the edge of frame
scene: The market as it is, with the tarpaulin colour cast and the crowd behind reduced to tone
lighting: Filtered daylight through the tarpaulin as key, with its real colour cast kept, plus a bounce off the pavement
camera: Standing height looking slightly down, 35mm behaviour, close enough to be at the stall
materials: Produce has variation and blemishes; the plastic stools are scuffed; the surfaces are wet
avoid: No colour-corrected tarpaulin light, no uniformly perfect produce, no emptied market
fails_when: The produce is graded to supermarket perfection; the whole reason to shoot a market is that it is not

job_vi: Bố cục Tết, quà biếu, lễ
job_en: A Tet or gifting composition
use_when: Seasonal gifting is the occasion driving the purchase
subject_action: The product as the clear subject with two or three seasonal objects placed as a household would place them, not arranged in a wreath
scene: A single-tone ground in the season's own palette, no printed backdrop
lighting: Soft source from front-left with a warm bounce, so red and gold read rich rather than orange
camera: 45 degrees above, 50mm behaviour
materials: Red reads as its real dye rather than pure saturation; gold reflects the room; the seasonal objects are real objects with real weight
avoid: No symmetric border of props, no floating blossoms, no invented festive text, no oversaturated red that loses the product colour
fails_when: The frame becomes a greeting card and the product disappears into the decoration

job_vi: Nền màu trơn để đặt chữ lên
job_en: A colour field built to carry type
use_when: The layout needs a background and the picture is not the message
copy_safe: 70 percent of the frame, stated explicitly
subject_action: No subject at all, or one small object at one edge as an anchor
scene: A single surface with one soft gradient across it, and one real texture at grazing angle
lighting: One large soft source from one side to make the gradient, nothing else
camera: Straight on, 50mm behaviour
materials: The surface must be a real material — paper, plaster, fabric — at a scale where its texture is visible but not busy
avoid: No pattern that competes with type, no vignette, no gradient banding, no rendered text
fails_when: The gradient bands in the darkest quarter and every piece of type sitting on it looks cheap

job_vi: Tách nguyên liệu để chứng minh thành phần
job_en: The components separated to prove what is in it
use_when: The claim is about ingredients or contents
subject_action: Each component in its own small group on one plane, in the proportion actually used, the finished product at one edge
scene: A plain single-tone surface
lighting: Flat soft light from directly above so nothing casts a shadow that reads as a hierarchy
camera: Straight down at 90 degrees, 50mm behaviour
materials: Every component present in the real proportion, with real variation; the quantities are a claim
avoid: No component the recipe does not contain, no ingredient enlarged for effect, no arranged spiral or grid pattern
fails_when: A component is shown at a proportion that flatters the formula. That is a claim, not styling, and it needs a source
